name: Research the test-only native third-spy Civic once from the preserved second failure

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.ThirdSpyCivicStatus(); assert(s.stage=='NOT_REQUESTED' and s.prerequisiteOwned and s.capacity==2,'third native spy research preconditions missing'); return s.stage

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_THIRD_SPY_CIVIC_INTENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_THIRD_SPY_CIVIC_INTENT' or a=='REJECTED_THIRD_SPY_CIVIC_INTENT' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_THIRD_SPY_CIVIC_INTENT'

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('THIRD_SPY_CIVIC'); return 'one official Civic research request queued'
